prompt: Cleanup volunteers can take a folding wagon on the bus only if it fits inside the marked luggage space. The west loading team lends compact wagons before 9:00, but its registration desk does not handle riverside check-in; that check-in is at the bridge before the 9:15 bus. Lu’s own wagon fits the luggage space, though it is wider than the compact loan wagons, so to keep it and join the bus Lu must _____.
promptZh: 清理活動的志工只有在折疊手推車能放進巴士標示行李空間時才能帶上車。西側裝運小組在 9:00 前借出小型推車，但其借用登記櫃檯不受理河岸報到；要搭 9:15 的車須先到橋邊報到。露自己的推車放得進行李區，雖比小型借車寬，因此要帶原車搭巴士，露必須_____。

options.text: exchange the wagon for a small one at the west desk and board at the bridge
options.zh: 在西側櫃檯換成小型推車，到橋邊搭車
options.whyZh: 原車已符合行李空間，換小車違反留用的前提。

options.text: take the original wagon to the bridge, check in there, and board the 9:15 bus
options.zh: 推原本的車到橋邊，在那裡報到並搭 9:15 巴士
options.whyZh: 原車可上巴士，但河岸報到須在橋邊完成。

options.text: keep the original wagon, check in at the west desk, and board at the bridge
options.zh: 留用原車，在西側櫃檯報到，再到橋邊搭車
options.whyZh: 西側櫃檯只受理借車登記，不能代替河岸報到。

options.text: leave the wagon at the bridge and board without it after checking in
options.zh: 把推車留在橋邊，報到後不帶車上巴士
options.whyZh: 可以帶原車上車，不必留在橋邊。

explanationZh: 原車可上巴士，但河岸報到須在橋邊完成。
evidence: fits inside the marked luggage space / does not handle riverside check-in / at the bridge before the 9:15 bus / Lu’s own wagon fits the luggage space

vocabulary.note: 指可摺疊收納、用來搬運物品的小型手拉車。
